lessons: The ticket's premise holds. The diff only adds a lint finding in clutch/tickets.py::lint_findings plus docs and tests, and the implementer reported unit tests and ticket lint passing. The blocker is outside the fence: tests/harness/host_loop.py:162 raises LoopRefused when a fixture run ends

A human should inspect why host-loop fixture runs (the 'escape' member in pytest-3034/popen-gw18) get a recovery_alert 'orphaned run' only under the full parallel integration run. They pass alone on both the base and the candidate, which points to load or timing in run recovery, not this diff.

No host-loop fixture uses a path-led ## Regression command. Grep shows tests use 'python', 'python3' or 'uv run python' with carried files. So the new program rule cannot plausibly change host-loop behavior. Fix the orphan-recovery flake in its own ticket, ordered ahead with ## Runs before.

When retrying after that fix, redo the same scope. In lint_findings, flag ticket.regression[0] when it contains '/' and no carries prefix equals it or is a directory prefix of it. Add the host-authoring.md sentence. Update test_ticket_lint_rules.py lines 75-76 to expect both findings. Add

Don't rerun the full integration gate until host-loop passes and then call that fixed. Compare the base and the candidate over the same number of full runs. One passing base run against two failing candidate runs doesn't prove the candidate caused the failure.
